designSummary: Systematic review with structured synthesis by strategy type and random-effects meta-analysis where at least three studies share a coded uptake definition and design.
sampleSize: No sample size applies to a review. The preliminary search reported 212 hits for one query; the full search is expected to yield about 1,500 records and 30 to 40 eligible studies. Pooling needs at least three studies per comparison; with fewer, effect estimates are tabulated with their intervals.
primaryAnalysis: Risk difference in clinician-reviewed measure use between strategy and comparator, pooled by random effects within strategy type where at least three comparable studies exist; otherwise structured synthesis following SWiM with vote counting by direction avoided.
secondaryAnalysis: Persistence after support ends; response or remission; subgroups by setting (community against psychiatry clinic) and by age group where reported.
missingData: Study authors are contacted once for missing denominators; studies without extractable data are described, not imputed.
multiplicity: One primary outcome; subgroups limited to two pre-specified factors.
software: Review software already licensed by the service; R for meta-analysis.
overfittingGuards: No meta-regression with fewer than ten studies
Uptake definitions coded before effect sizes are extracted
summary: Structured synthesis with pooling only for comparable studies.
